headline: The IBEX 35 accelerates sales and puts the 19,600 points at risk
summary: The IBEX 35 is accelerating its sales and risks falling to 19,600 points. The options and futures closing will influence the session, which ends a week marked by central bank meetings.
why: The IBEX 35 is Spain's main stock benchmark, tracking the largest companies listed on the Madrid exchange, so its moves reflect the Spanish equity market.

impacts.name: IBEX 35
impacts.why: The index is under selling pressure and is at risk of falling to 19,600 points around derivatives expiry.
